method: Read-only diff review against migration schema, runtime authority callers and actual local reproduction; no production DB requests

findings.title: New transport promotes requested-only persisted mask identity to actual provenance
findings.evidence: raster_asset_persistence.py:105 stores cloud-mask/1 when req.apply_cloud_mask is true, even if stats.cloud_mask_applied is false and validated provenance.qa_mask_version is null. New fetch_latest_asset/reload transport returns that declaration. Actual quality_gate changes from false to true with the hydrated-equivalent payload.
findings.required_fix: Persist observed validated mask identity, and do not trust legacy requested-only mask metadata as observed evidence. Preserve missing/false QA as missing.
findings.required_test: Requested mask true but absent/false actual mask: persist -> hydrate -> grid -> vegetation quality_gate must remain nonexecutable. Include historical row with cloud-mask/1 and absent/false actual-mask proof plus a genuinely applied identity positive case.

findings.title: created_at is not availability of the currently replaced product
findings.evidence: db_persist.py:197-215 ON CONFLICT updates cog_uri, provenance and quality without updating created_at. New mapping exports the earlier insertion time as data_available_at for the newer product, enabling historical availability attribution before newer samples existed. Fresh in-memory now and restarted row created_at also disagree.
findings.required_fix: Store exact current product publication time as explicit provenance or dedicated version timestamp; legacy unknown version availability must remain unknown. Avoid relabelling initial row creation as current COG availability.
findings.required_test: Write same product_identity twice at t1/t2 with different COG/provenance; hydrated availability must equal actual t2 or remain unknown, never t1 for new content.

non_findings.radiometry: No new production calibration release found. Optional exact-asset calibration rejects ambiguous legacy collection, contradictory BOA flag, invalid numeric values and TIFF conflict. Search retains metadata only. Does not close provider calibration gap.
non_findings.inventory_sql: Compared selected columns with migrations v14/v114/v116/v144/v154; no undefined selected column found. Every query carries tenant predicate and limit+1, errors propagate, transaction read-only/repeatable-read, role/policy checks and truncation marker preserve honest scope. No native PostgreSQL execution performed in this review.
non_findings.limits: Authors were still modifying files. This review is bound to saved file hashes and needs recheck after correction.

observations: Legacy requested-only qa version does not survive actual false or missing mask proof into vegetation authority. Positive applied-mask case still executable.
Two writes to same product identity hydrate current COG publication timestamp t2, never old created_at t1. Legacy publication time remains unknown.
limits: SQL network I/O simulated; native PostgreSQL and production acceptance not claimed.
No broad optional testing performed; root owns full raster suite and governed preflight.
